# Tomato poda

By Ahimanikya Satapathy

Oriyarasoi roasts until the tomato’s skin blackens, then rests, peels and chops it into chunks. Mustard oil and aromatics follow. The author uses knife and spoon rather than hand-mashing.[^1]

[^1]: [Oriyarasoi, Roasted Tomato Salsa (aka Bilati Baigana poda from Odisha) (2015).](https://www.oriyarasoi.com/2015/11/roasted-tomato-salsa-aka-bilati-baigana.html)
